mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, user_id, total_amount, address_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, status, items, remark ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{addressId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, 0, #{items}, #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status=1, pay_time=NOW() WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status=0
